fact: In May 2025 MTN Uganda paid $13.3m and Airtel Uganda $9.9m (UGX 37.9 billion, 2% of 2024 gross revenue) into the state-run Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund, a licence obligation, taking it to $23.2m in two days.
title: Telecom giants back Uganda's digital future
why_not: off-topic: universal service levies paid to the state, not investment in a digital business
